## About the business
Image Paradise Photography provides candid, traditional and cinematic wedding photography and videography. The service covers weddings, engagements, bridal portraits, pre-wedding sessions, family celebrations and album design.

## Service area
Chennai, Tiruvallur, Avadi, Ambattur and other Tamil Nadu locations. Destination wedding coverage is available by prior arrangement.
